title: IPO Market: vVARDIS Prices Below Range, ByteDance at $400B
summary: IPO market: vVARDIS prices its NYSE IPO at $18, below range, as Anthropic sets terms and ByteDance plans a $6B buyback at a $400B valuation.
body_markdown:
Underwriters hold a 30-day option to buy up to 1,458,333 more shares at the IPO price, and Goldman Sachs and J.P. Morgan lead the deal as joint bookrunners, per the same report. Before pricing,[Renaissance Capital](https://www.renaissancecapital.com/IPO-Center/News/122632/us-ipo-week-ahead-dental-tech-vvardis-and-biotech-rezera-on-deck-as) listed terms of about 9.5 million shares at the range to raise $214 million.


The company sells Curodont, a treatment for early-stage cavities applied in a dental office without drilling or needles, and reaches more than 20,000 US general dental practices, according to Renaissance Capital. Finimize noted that the FDA has not determined Curodont's safety or efficacy, as it is sold in the US as an over-the-counter drug, and that the founding Abivardi sisters have pledged about 10.3 million shares as collateral for personal loans.


In Finimize's reading, pricing below the range shows the IPO window can look open while public investors still demand a discount for uncertainty.


## When Is the Anthropic IPO Date?


Anthropic is expected to price its IPO and begin trading on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT in the week of November 16, 2026, according to[Renaissance Capital](https://www.renaissancecapital.com/IPO-Center/News/122657/anthropic-sets-terms-for-61-billion-ipo-targeting-a-1.2-trillion-market-cap) . The company set terms on November 10 to sell 825 million shares, 3% of them from existing holders, at $70 to $78 each, raising about $61 billion.


At the midpoint, the range implies a fully diluted market value of about $1.2 trillion, excluding $111 billion of convertible debt, per Renaissance Capital. At the top of the range with the underwriters' option exercised, the IPO would raise about $74 billion, second only to[SpaceX](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/spacex-spcx-stock-news-november-13-2026/) 's $75 billion listing, the firm said.


[Reuters](https://www.timeslive.co.za/news/business/2026-11-10-anthropic-lowers-ipo-valuation-target-to-102-trillion/) put the IPO at up to $64.4 billion, with a fully diluted valuation of about $1.4 trillion at the top of the range and about $1 trillion on a non-diluted basis. Investors had earlier discussed a valuation of up to $2 trillion before Anthropic's infrastructure commitments and recent volatility in AI stocks lowered expectations, Reuters reported.


> "The timing of this IPO likely contributed to the lighter valuation and lighter cash raise," Jeff Zell, senior research analyst at IPO Boutique, told Reuters.


## What Is ByteDance Worth in Its New Buyback?


The planned buyback values ByteDance at about $400 billion, roughly 20% above the about $330 billion used in the previous buyback a year earlier,[according to investingLive](https://investinglive.com/stocks/bytedance-plans-6bn-share-buyback-at-about-400-billion-valuation-up-20-in-a-year/) , citing The Information. Earlier buybacks valued the company at about $268 billion in late 2023 and about $300 billion a year after that, the outlet said.


The new mark still sits below a minority-stake deal that reportedly valued ByteDance at about $480 billion late last year, investingLive added.


## How Is the IPO Market Doing in 2026?


The Renaissance IPO Index was down 4.0% for the year as of November 5, against an 8.4% gain in the S&P 500, according to[Renaissance Capital](https://www.renaissancecapital.com/IPO-Center/News/122632/us-ipo-week-ahead-dental-tech-vvardis-and-biotech-rezera-on-deck-as) , which said tech stocks fell sharply after US midterm results raised fears of an AI crackdown. Higher borrowing costs, geopolitical turmoil and elevated bond yields are weighing on new listings, leaving Anthropic among the few major companies going public this fall,[Reuters reported](https://www.timeslive.co.za/news/business/2026-11-10-anthropic-lowers-ipo-valuation-target-to-102-trillion/) .
